items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag bis zum 03.12.2026 auf das Vereinskonto.

items.quote: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 10.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date, 10.12.2026, for the next automatic direct debit under the separate contract DX-2411-496. That date (Thursday) is a regular business day in NW, so no adjustment is needed; this is informational (automatic collection), not an action required from the person, but it is included as an upcoming financial event.

warnings: This is a reminder from a sports club, not a public authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery or legal-remedy rules apply; the dates are simply those printed in the letter.

Before paying, confirm the club's IBAN (DE39 3705 0198 0005 5191 10) matches what you already have on file or on the club's official website, since a failed direct debit followed by a payment request to an account is a pattern also used in scams (the IBAN itself is well-formed, which does not prove it is correct).

The letter invites changing bank details by simply sending a new SEPA mandate without further verification ('Hat sich Ihre Bankverbindung geändert, schicken Sie uns einfach ein neues SEPA-Mandat.'); only do this through contact channels you already trust, not in reply to an unsolicited request.
